prompt:
Our fintech platform uses a `transaction-validator` skill that was security-audited and certified safe when it was first published. Since then, it has been forked and extended by several internal teams, and we are now on the 5th generation of that skill.

Before we deploy the Gen 5 version to production agents, our compliance officer wants to know: how far has this skill drifted from what was originally audited? Has it gained capabilities that the original audit never covered? Is a re-audit required?

Please analyze the full inheritance chain of the `transaction-validator` skill (you can find the version files and lineage metadata in the marketplace directory of the workspace) and produce a file called `drift_report.txt` containing a complete evolution drift analysis. The report should give us everything we need to make a go/no-go decision on re-auditing.
